Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes—damage/defect is handled differently than a standard “changed my mind” return.
If it arrived damaged in transit, it’s treated as a replacement/assistance case (not a normal return). We ask you to inspect and report it quickly (within 48 hours), and you’ll typically need photos of the item and packaging; for shipping damage, Kingston can replace the product at no cost or provide store credit.
A normal return generally requires an RMA and is subject to a 25% restocking fee (with exceptions—shipping damage is one of them).
